component.name: Plasma Theme Studio
component.summary: Edit every part of a KDE Plasma theme in one place
Redigera alla delar av ett KDE Plasma-tema på ett ställe

description.p: Plasma Theme Studio keeps a whole desktop theme in one file and writes the files that KDE Plasma and its apps read. You edit a value once, see it in a preview, and apply it to the running desktop.
Every apply takes a snapshot first, so it can be undone from the app or from a text console. The app only writes inside your home folder and shows the exact files it is about to write.
This first version edits and applies the color scheme. Window decoration, widget style, Plasma style, GTK and Rofi are planned.
First development version: theme file, colors, apply, undo and snapshots.
